# Code Anchors: Removal Gate

- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — the pre-filing checkpoint: asks the checker for the list, transcribes it in a fence, takes cuts against one sequence, passes the approved body only for a closed record, and refuses a frozen line with its route.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/record-offer.ts` — selects every refuted alternative and every model-added invariant and risk, numbers them as one sequence, and marks a line the approved body carries as frozen.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/record-offer.spec.ts` — pins the selection, the asked-for exclusion, the one numbering sequence and the frozen marking.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/render.ts` — renders the record checklist ticked, grouped by kind under its own headings.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — exposes the record mode of the checklist verb, with the approved body as an optional local file.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.spec.ts` — pins the record mode of the checklist verb end to end.
- `components/skills/nxs-razor/SKILL.md` — states the removal convention over the shared shape, and why an asked-for invariant or risk is not listed.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/scope-razor-authoring.spec.ts` — pins the stage's wording that the list comes from the checker and covers every model-added invariant and risk.
